title: Case Prism exact-file actionability and institutional-memory closure
purpose: Add one controlled finite test and one receipt/knowledge classification for every public exact proceeding while preserving the narrower shared-proposition matrix, evidence gaps and legal separateness.

authorization.scope: Implement, verify, publish and close the recorded Case Prism substantive implementation gaps through the normal PR, CI, merge, Pages and live-verification chain.

coverage_meaning.finite_test: A complete finite-test object must be exact-file-specific: unique decision dependency, strongest contrary explanation, confirmed/refuted consequences, canonical public-record route and an explicit primary-source route or route gap. A recorded custodian/organ is only a candidate and may not be treated as legally competent, empowered or obliged to act; any consequence remains conditional on exact competence and a lawful route. The contrary explanation remains hypothetical and attributes no act to the candidate without a primary source. Canonical record type precedes a mixed Stream substring when assigning the UI-only family. Generic registry-maintenance, source-retrieval or record-correction boilerplate cannot count. NOT_LOCATED remains permissible and structural coverage is not primary-source or merits completion.
coverage_meaning.receipt_knowledge: Classification coverage and positive evidence are separate. Each of nine institutional axes—transmission, material received/inventory, referral, registration, file incorporation, recipient attribution, substantive examination, decision use and cross-file acknowledgement—requires its own status, bilingual basis, bilingual limitation and controlled source or source-gap object. Every positive grade must cite the exact episode field that supports that axis; episode-and-axis overrides are required where a global default would cite unrelated text. Transmission and referral are independent. Institutional handling cannot establish actor-specific receipt or knowledge.
coverage_meaning.actor_specific: Actor-specific receipt and knowledge remain non-positive unless an actor-specific source identifies the person, material or act, time and permissible evidential scope.
coverage_meaning.fiscalia: Twenty-four public Master Register rows—21 exact and three unresolved references—receive separate source-attributed material, received-inventory-gap, direct/context proceeding, related-asset-gap, referred, actually-examined, response, cross-file, unitary, contrary and unanswered dispositions. Only reviewed event-to-matter relationships may support the eight profiled matrix rows. A ninth response episode profiles the separate DP 1901/2026 judicial file outside the matrix.
coverage_meaning.routing: Master Register, exact trace and isolation routes are required for every public exact ID. Dedicated narrative dossiers are a separately counted optional positive route.
coverage_meaning.case_prism: The finite-test layer does not add the 71 no-coordinate proceedings to a shared proposition or lane.

known_open_gaps.description: Two of 33 controlled direct relationship pairs remain source-reported/pending primary completion.
The finite shared-proposition matrix covers 26 of 97 exact proceedings; 71 retain an explicit no-coordinate gap.
Case Prism treatment sources remain controlled at proposition level rather than asserted as complete cell-specific source proof.
CP-GAP-004 and CP-GAP-005 preserve the unclosed global procurador and filing denominators.
Dedicated bilingual narrative dossiers remain a partial positive subset; Master/trace/isolation navigation must not be relabelled as dedicated-dossier completeness.
The tracked operational Master Register CSV remains publicly HTTP-accessible as a pre-existing accepted publication-boundary gap.

accepted_publication_boundary_gap.qualification: The renderer must use only allowlisted public projections. Continued CSV exposure is observed separately and must not become an intended publication invariant.
